name: Cauldron of the Vermintoll Coven

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from the Crooked Nightmare; the book's numbers, our words. Its Tiny-to-Medium size change, Cookpot, Vermincall and Fortifying Gorge wait on the engine's heirloom rules.

summary: A big iron pot the coven cooked in: a spellcasting focus that adds +1 to all saving throws (its heirloom powers wait on the engine).
